No. The evidence covers only the 2,843.1 ha asset, not the surrounding region, so it cannot establish whether forest loss occurred regionally.

Within the asset, no tree-cover loss event of at least 0.5 ha was detected during 2021–2025. Smaller patches totaling 0.4 ha were recorded in 2021 but were below the event threshold. Earlier loss events were recorded within the asset before the baseline.
